items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Johnny Carson was looking for an apartment at Trump's; a two-million dollar apartment at Trump Towers.

ctx.x: They're opening studios here. Tootsie was made here in this studio right across from my house. Johnny Carson was looking for an apartment at Trump's; a two-million dollar apartment at Trump Towers.
I mean, when you look at the New York scene in the New Yorker each week, there's quite a few piano players working, but there aren't any bands working.
